## Week 8 Notes

Moran's I of the residuals - do errors cluster?
In your model log, it should fall as you add features.

But a single number can't tell you where to look.

C       +20k       +4              B,D         -1
D       -50k       -66             C,E         -41

Four quadrants, read as errors
Residual = actual-predicted. High = we guessed too low

                         Neighbors under-predicted       Neighbors over-predicted
I'm under-predicted      High-High                       High-Low
I'm over-predicted       Low-High                        Low-Low

HH: I'm > mean   Neighbors>mean
HL: I'm > mean   Neighbors<mean
LH: I'm < mean   Neighbors>mean
LL: Pocket of over-prediction
